serviceReschedule.title: Move the appointment
serviceReschedule.lead: Suggest another time without cancelling: same length, same terms. The appointment only changes if the other party accepts before the deadline.
serviceReschedule.pendingByPage: The page suggests a new time
serviceReschedule.pendingByRequester: The requester suggests a new time
serviceReschedule.deadline: Answer expected before {{date}}. Without agreement, the appointment stays as it is.
serviceReschedule.acceptDescription: The appointment moves to the new time; the length and the accepted terms do not change.
serviceReschedule.next: New time suggested, answer expected before {{date}}

form.duration_one: Same length ({{count}} minute) and same terms: only the time changes.
form.duration_other: Same length ({{count}} minutes) and same terms: only the time changes.
form.timeZone: Time zone of the new time
form.timeZoneHint: The date and time are read in this time zone.
form.deadlineHint: At most 14 days after sending, before the new time and before the current time.

errors.reschedule_already_open: A new time is already waiting for an answer: accept, decline or withdraw it first.
errors.reschedule_not_open: No new time is waiting for an answer: it was withdrawn, declined, or its deadline has passed.
errors.reschedule_same_slot: This is already the appointment time: choose another time.
errors.reschedule_changed: The new time changed in the meantime: read it again before accepting.
